{{Quote|All my life, I've heard tales of the Great Tirahnn Fair, but I never thought I'd get to visit it.|Luke Skywalker to Leia Organa|<ref name="Star Wars Annual (1977) 1">[[Star Wars Annual (1977) 1|''Star Wars Annual'' (1977) 1]]</ref>}}
The '''Great Fair''' was a gigantic bazaar located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tirahnn/Legends|Tirahnn]]. Nestled in the [[Tirahnn (city)|city of the same name]], the fair catered to the entire world but was also well known throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], drawing huge crowds.
